sql:
/* D0 cohort: participant vs non-participant outcomes; association only, not causal. */
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' ts, DATE '2026-08-02' te, DATE '2026-05-08' ss),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体' grp,c.u FROM SC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u),
Cohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id" FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
E AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) day_n,e."#event_name" ev,e."#event_time" et,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) stage_type,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) stage_id,e.a_rst
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",DATE_DIFF('day',c.ss,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)),e."#event_name",e."#event_time",TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER),TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT),e.a_rst
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
Gaps AS (SELECT grp,aid,DATE_DIFF('second',CAST(et AS TIMESTAMP),LEAD(CAST(et AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp,aid,day_n ORDER BY et)) gap FROM E WHERE ev NOT LIKE '%app%'),
UserMins AS (SELECT grp,aid,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gap BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN gap ELSE 0 END)/60.0,2) active_mins FROM Gaps GROUP BY 1,2),
UserBase AS (
 SELECT c.grp,c.aid,MAX(CASE WHEN e.ev='login' AND e.day_n=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r1,MAX(CASE WHEN e.ev='login' AND e.day_n=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r3,MAX(CASE WHEN e.ev='login' AND e.day_n=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r4,
   COALESCE(MAX(um.active_mins),0) active_mins,
   MAX(CASE WHEN e.ev='stage_fight' AND e.stage_type=1001 THEN e.stage_id ELSE 0 END) max_mainline
 FROM Cohort c LEFT JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid LEFT JOIN UserMins um ON c.grp=um.grp AND c.aid=um.aid GROUP BY 1,2
),
ModeUsers AS (
 SELECT c.grp,c.aid,'主线副本' mode FROM Cohort c JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid WHERE e.ev='stage_fight' AND e.stage_type=1001 GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,c.aid,'挑战玩具小偷' FROM Cohort c JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid WHERE e.ev='stage_fight' AND e.stage_type=1002 GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,c.aid,'挑战怪物扭蛋人' FROM Cohort c JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid WHERE e.ev='stage_fight' AND e.stage_type=1003 GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,c.aid,'三消' FROM Cohort c JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid WHERE e.ev='match3_combo' GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,c.aid,'游乐园' FROM Cohort c JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid WHERE e.ev='item_change' AND ANY_MATCH(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=430001 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)) GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
AllModes AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('主线副本'),('挑战玩具小偷'),('挑战怪物扭蛋人'),('三消'),('游乐园')) AS t(mode)),
Segment AS (
 SELECT c.grp,m.mode,CASE WHEN u.aid IS NOT NULL THEN '参与' ELSE '未参与' END segment,b.aid,b.r1,b.r3,b.r4,b.active_mins,b.max_mainline
 FROM Cohort c CROSS JOIN AllModes m JOIN UserBase b ON c.grp=b.grp AND c.aid=b.aid LEFT JOIN ModeUsers u ON c.grp=u.grp AND c.aid=u.aid AND m.mode=u.mode
)
SELECT grp AS "group_name",mode AS "mode",segment AS "segment",COUNT(*) AS "users",ROUND(100.0*AVG(r1),2) AS "r1_pct",ROUND(100.0*AVG(r3),2) AS "r3_pct",ROUND(100.0*AVG(r4),2) AS "r4_pct",ROUND(AVG(active_mins),1) AS "active_mins",ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN max_mainline>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),2) AS "mainline_reach_pct"
FROM Segment GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3;
